summary.text: William Bailey is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 104, which he has represented since November 12, 2018, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat George Blumenthal is also on the general election ballot for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Bailey was first assigned to committees in the 2019-2020 session, when he served on the Interstate Cooperation Committee and the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee.
He later served on the House Legislative Oversight Committee in 2023-2024, and for 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee, on which he also served in earlier sessions.
